sequence: validate all diagnostic input hashes and structural cardinalities
construct and freeze anonymous lane timing/resource summary without loading named identity mapping
load the frozen identity and schedule mappings and validate their exact one-to-one correspondence
produce named engineering runtime distributions, G x N x F cells, tail and execution-order diagnostics
produce a parameterized formal-ST collection-time table and the 7-day decision gate
freeze report, file manifest, and terminal receipt

quantiles.method: linear interpolation at p*(n-1) over sorted finite values

tailRules.orderStrata: lane execution index thirds: early 0..323, middle 324..647, late 648..971
tailRules.smallCellRule: report n, minimum, P50, maximum; do not treat P99 from n=3 as a stable population estimate

directTimingMeasures.interProcessGapMilliseconds: next process creationTimeUtc minus prior process exitedAtUtc
directTimingMeasures.laneBodyMilliseconds: lane-receipt laneWallClockMilliseconds; frozen RunnerV3 starts this stopwatch at RunAlgorithmLane entry and stops it after all lane work and raw writes
directTimingMeasures.unityStartup: not separately identifiable because no trustworthy absolute workloadStartUtc exists
directTimingMeasures.exitFinalization: not separately identifiable because no trustworthy absolute workloadEndUtc exists
directTimingMeasures.residualComponents: must not be labeled as startup, compute, or finalization

formalStPrediction.scope: algorithm-lane collection plus observed strict-serial inter-process gaps; excludes input generation, oracle prechecks, post-collection validation, delivery, and analysis
formalStPrediction.allowedB: positive multiples of 36; final B is not yet frozen
formalStPrediction.pointFormula: for each algorithm x core G x N x F cell, use the P50 of its three pilot process walls; sum 288 cells and add 288 pooled lane-gap P50 values; multiply by B
formalStPrediction.conservativeFormula: for each algorithm x core G x N x F cell, use the maximum of its three pilot process walls; sum 288 cells and add 288 pooled lane-gap P99 values; multiply by B
formalStPrediction.planningBudgetFormula: conservative estimate multiplied by 1.20 operational headroom

scientificBoundary: This is a post-validation descriptive engineering diagnostic. It is not a formal algorithm-effect comparison, does not use qualification rows as formal samples, and does not authorize deleting algorithms, changing the question, shrinking samples, changing stopping rules, or launching ST, MQ, or MT.
